name: FPV T12c Rescue Low At Home

metadata.description: Validation test for the GPS Rescue start gate (docs/fpv-hud-gnss-test-plan.md, T12c): Alt Hold at about 2.5 m, about 1 m from home, then the rescue switch at 6 s. Within 5 m of home and below the 4 m landing altitude (alt_est, height above the arming point), Betaflight aborts and disarms at once, in the air as on the ground.
